description: Historical ground-motion time series for a US address — the per-date satellite measurements of vertical displacement over time (how the land has moved, month by month). Use to see the TREND of subsidence/uplift, not just the current velocity. series_type "measured" = real per-pass observations (premium frames); "modeled" = fitted trend on real acquisition dates. Needs a SibFly key for the full series ($0.40); keyless returns a coverage teaser.

_apiKey.description: Optional SibFly API key (Bearer). With a key you get the full paid report; without one you get a free coverage/confidence teaser. Free key: POST https://sibfly.com/api/v1/autonomous/register.

address.description: US street address, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington DC". Provide this OR lat+lon.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lon instead of address.

lon.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

series_type.description: "measured" (real per-pass observations) or "modeled" (fitted trend). Default measured.

name: sibfly_timeseries
title: Sibfly Timeseries
